message.content:
To retrieve just the **IDs** of the CNAME records for `sample.com` via VirusTotal’s API you can follow this simple pattern:

```http
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records?type=CNAME
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

Replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with your real key (e.g., `secret123`).  
The response will look something like this (simplified):

```json
{
  "data": [
    { "id": "dns_record_1", ... },
    { "id": "dns_record_2", ... }
  ]
}
```

Extract the `"id"` values from each object in the `"data"` array. Those are the identifiers you’re looking for. If you prefer a quick script, here’s a minimal example in Python:

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records"
headers = {"x-apikey": "secret123"}   # <-- replace with your key
params = {"type": "CNAME"}

resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
ids = [item["id"] for item in resp.json()["data"]]
print(ids)   # e.g., ['dns_record_1', 'dns_record_2']
```

That will give you a list of the CNAME record IDs for `sample.com`.
